APPROVE

The loop body moves unchanged into `Evaluate`, with `own` inlined and the early `return Strictness.Unknown` on `known == 0` folded into a ternary, so `Read` still returns on the first candidate that has text. Complexity drops well below 15 (`Evaluate` is about 7, and `Read` is smaller than before). The change adds only a private static method with no new warning sources visible in the diff, though I did not build it.
